question: Find the largest number which completely divides 24, 56 and 96.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the **largest number** that divides given numbers, find the **Highest Common Factor (HCF)**.

Check the difference between the closest numbers: 56 − 24 = 32 and 96 − 56 = 40.

The HCF must be a factor of the difference (40 − 32 = 8).

Check if 8 divides 24, 56, and 96: 24/8=3, 56/8=7, 96/8=12. All are divisible.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81ca8994e9bdd34a7e4f87850a9780a74662b742c5f81104c2432735dbf4a1c7.png] 

**Given:** Numbers are 24, 56, and 96.

**Formula:** The **largest number** dividing all is the **HCF** of the numbers.

⇒ Prime factorization of 24 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 = 2³ × 3¹

⇒ Prime factorization of 56 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 7 = 2³ × 7¹

⇒ Prime factorization of 96 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 = 2⁵ × 3¹

⇒ HCF = Product of lowest powers of common prime factors

⇒ HCF = 2³ = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

It is the **greatest divisor** that divides two or more integers without a remainder.

Least Common Multiple (LCM)

The **smallest positive integer** that is divisible by each of the given numbers.

HCF and LCM Relation

For two numbers a and b, **HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b**.</p
